findings.text: The specified statements-or-refusal response assumes it can replace every caller, but `native_replay.without_trailing_queries` needs grammar-level command information even when translation refuses SQL such as `PRAGMA table_info(t)`. Fix: require the program to preserve the command information needed for this projection when translation fails.

The task says the S1 report names the commit for its commands, but `experiments/surface-s1/README.md` contains no commit reference. Fix: require adding the measurement commit reference before deleting the commands’ dependencies.
